title: 第21章 外出试炼第22章 吞噬妖兽
lines: 韧带断裂，在这个世界并不难治。
江尘盯着还在不断叫嚣的江明，只遗憾刚刚没有让他少个零件。
只受到这点伤势，实在难解心头之恨。
不过，眼下面对这样一位江家高手，也只能见好就收了，不能太过放肆。
江尘无视了江明的叫嚣，对江忠林拱了拱手，正色道：“忠林族老，上次在大比擂台上，您帮我拦下了江旭的攻击，小子十分感激。”
“至于这次的事件，起因如何大家都不是傻子。”
“这江明一边调虎离山，引走了我爹他们，一边带人群殴江虎，所说的话我们可是听得清清楚楚。”
“之后更是对一个七岁小丫头出手，这样畜生，我只是斩了他一剑，难道过份吗？”
“须知这里可是大齐皇朝，玄武城也是齐阳城主的玄武城，而不是江家的玄武城。”
“若真要追究下去，我愿与江明对簿公堂，让城主大人为我们决断，看看到底是谁的错！”
江尘之所以这么说，自然不是确定城主会为自己说话，而是刻意引导，暗示自己会将事情闹大。
玄武城中明令禁止，不可故意致人伤残，不可杀人，否则将受到严惩。
现在只是小范围的矛盾冲突倒还罢了。
若是闹到全城皆知，舆论一旦起来，吃亏更多的肯定不会是江尘自己。
“你倒是伶牙俐齿，不像个十岁小娃娃。”
江忠林笑了笑，将自己的长剑收回剑鞘，对江明说道：“走吧，我带你去治手！”
江明见状勃然色变：“族老，那江尘可是伤了我，你就算不杀了他，也得给他一个教训！”
“你可别忘了，我爷爷可是让你保护我的，现在我被击伤，你却不出手，难道就不怕我爷爷责怪下来？”
江忠林被江明这个小辈吆五喝六吼了几遍，也有些恼了，一身武师气势压向江明，冷哼道：“江明，你听清楚了，有点天赋是你运气好，但过于骄狂，就是在给自己埋祸了！”
“还有，老夫守护家族数十载，连你爷爷都不敢轻易惹怒我，你算个什么东西？”
“这江家，还轮不到你来指挥我！”
武师高阶的威压临身，江明脸色变了又变，最终只能狠狠瞪一眼江尘，跟着江忠林离开。
不多时，江战等人收到消息匆匆赶来。
当听到雪儿也因此受牵连被踢伤后，江战愧疚道：“雪儿，是爹不对，这两天晕头转向，竟连这点粗浅伎俩都没看破。”
“或许，我不该带着你们脱离江家……”
“爹，你没有错！”
江尘安慰道。
“就凭那父子俩的性格，再加上家主偏袒，我们留在江家受到的针对只会更多。”
江战闻言叹了口气。
在这个世界，无能便是原罪。
现在想来，自己当初实在太蠢，居然为了所谓的家族利益，不顾自己的安危。
沦落到今天的地步，也算是罪有应得。
“走吧，我们回去，这店铺开着也没什么意思，我们回去再想点别的出路。”
江战招呼道。
“爹，我就不回去了，我的修炼到了瓶颈，需要外出历练一番。”
江尘说道。
听到这话，江战顿时一愣。
“你的意思是，你要去野外？”
“是，我如今已开辟十八条经脉，但实战经验不多，我准备独自历练，等过些天再回来。”
江尘没有说是为了吞噬妖兽，只说是为了实战。
江战以及其他族人听到这话，顿时惊了，一周不见，这小子从十二条经脉开辟到十八条了？
没有资源供给的情况下，纵然是身怀五品武魂的江明也做不到吧？
是不是偷吃什么好东西了？
江战面带狐疑，连他也开始怀疑江尘吃了什么天材地宝。
这种事也不罕见。
content_en:
Ligament rupture is not difficult to treat in this world.
Jiang Chen stared at Jiang Ming, who was still shouting, and regretted that he was not missing a part just now.
With only this little injury, it is really difficult to explain the hatred in my heart.
However, facing such a master of the Jiang family now, we can only accept it as soon as it's good, and we can't be too presumptuous.
Jiang Chen ignored Jiang Ming's shouting, bowed his hand to Jiang Zhonglin, and said seriously: "Old Zhonglin, you helped me stop Jiang Xu's attack in the competition arena last time. I am very grateful."
"As for this incident, no matter what the cause, everyone is not a fool."
"Jiang Ming lured the tiger away from the mountain and lured my father and others away. At the same time, he led a group of people to beat Jiang Hu. We heard what he said clearly."
"Then I attacked a seven-year-old girl. I just killed such a beast. Isn't that too much?"
"It should be noted that this is the Qi Dynasty, and Xuanwu City is also the Xuanwu City of Qi Yang City Lord, not the Jiang family's Xuanwu City."
"If we really want to pursue the case, I am willing to go to court with Jiang Ming and let the city lord make the decision for us to see who is at fault!"
The reason why Jiang Chen said this was naturally not because he was sure that the city lord would speak for him, but because he was deliberately guiding him, implying that he would make things worse.
It is expressly prohibited in Xuanwu City. Do not intentionally injure or kill others, otherwise you will be severely punished.
Now it's just a small-scale conflict.
If the riot becomes known to the whole city and public opinion rises, it will definitely not be Jiang Chen himself who suffers more.
"You are very sharp-tongued, not like a ten-year-old child."
Jiang Zhonglin smiled, put his long sword back into its scabbard, and said to Jiang Ming, "Let's go, I'll take you to treat your hand!"
Jiang Ming's expression changed suddenly when he saw this: "Elder of the clan, Jiang Chen hurt me. Even if you don't kill him, you still have to teach him a lesson!"
"Don't forget, my grandfather asked you to protect me. Now that I'm injured and you don't take action, aren't you afraid that my grandfather will blame me?"
Jiang Zhonglin was yelled at several times by Jiang Ming, a junior, and he was a little annoyed. He pressed on Jiang Ming with the aura of a martial artist, and snorted: "Jiang Ming, you heard clearly, you are lucky to have some talent, but if you are too arrogant, you are bringing trouble for yourself!"
"Also, I have been protecting the family for decades, and even your grandfather dare not offend me easily. Who do you think you are?"
"It's not your turn to command me in this Jiang family!"
Jiang Ming's face changed again and again as the high-level martial artist's pressure came upon him. In the end, he could only glare at Jiang Chen and follow Jiang Zhonglin away.
Not long after, Jiang Zhan and others rushed over after receiving the news.
When he heard that Xue'er was also involved and was kicked and injured, Jiang Zhan said guiltily: "Xue'er, it's my father's fault. I've been so confused these past two days that I didn't even see through this superficial trick."
"Maybe I shouldn't take you away from the Jiang family..."
"Dad, you are not wrong!"
Jiang Chen consoled him.
"Based on the personalities of the father and son, coupled with the favoritism of the family head, we will only be targeted more when we stay in the Jiang family."
Jiang Zhan sighed after hearing this.
In this world, incompetence is the original sin.
Now that I think about it, I was so stupid to ignore my own safety for the so-called family interests.
Being reduced to today's situation can be regarded as deserved.
"Let's go back. There's no point in keeping this store open. Let's go back and think of another way out."
Jiang Zhan greeted.
"Dad, I won't go back. My cultivation has reached a bottleneck and I need to go out to practice."
Jiang Chen said.
Hearing this, Jiang Zhan was stunned.
"You mean, you're going to the wild?"
"Yes, I have opened eighteen meridians now, but I don't have much practical experience. I plan to practice it alone and come back in a few days."
Jiang Chen didn't say it was for the purpose of devouring monsters, he only said it was for actual combat.
When Jiang Zhan and other clan members heard this, they were immediately shocked. After not seeing each other for a week, this kid had opened up his meridians from twelve to eighteen?
Without resource supply, even Jiang Ming, who possesses a fifth-grade martial spirit, can't do it, right?
Did you steal something good?
Jiang Zhan looked suspicious, and even he began to wonder what kind of treasure Jiang Chen had eaten.
This is not uncommon either.
